name: seoandoh-recorder
description: Ask about your SEO&OH voice recorder recordings: list, summaries, transcripts and search.

interface.longDescription:
SEO&OH Recorder lets you ask ChatGPT about the recordings you made with your SEO&OH voice recorder (mini recorder, USB recorder, pen recorder) and the AI notes created in the SEO&OH Recorder app.

What you can do:
- List your recent recordings with date, length and tags
- Read the AI summary, key points and action items of a recording
- Read the full transcript with speakers and timestamps
- Search across your transcripts and summaries for a word or topic

Privacy by design: recordings are not stored on our servers. When you ask, the request is passed to your own SEO&OH Recorder app (PC program or phone app) signed in with the same account, which reads the files on your device and returns only the requested text. The request is deleted right after it is answered.

Requirements and limitations:
- Sign in with your SEO&OH Recorder account (purchase-verified).
- Your SEO&OH Recorder PC program or phone app must be open and online to answer.
- Read-only: it never edits, deletes or uploads recordings. Audio files are never sent; only text.
- Transcripts and summaries are mostly in Korean.
defaultPrompt: Find recordings where we talked about the budget.

positive.prompt: Show me my recent SEO&OH recordings.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of the account's recordings (newest first) with title, recorded date, length and whether AI notes exist. The number of items depends on the account's data.

positive.prompt: Summarize my recording '신제품 출시 일정 회의' (new product launch schedule meeting).
positive.expected_behavior: Finds that recording and returns its AI summary: production was delayed, so the launch date was moved; packaging design and certification status are mentioned, plus the action items.

positive.prompt: Find the recording where we talked about 단가 (unit price) with a supplier.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the recording '거래처 납품 단가 미팅' with the matching transcript lines (time, speaker, text).

positive.prompt: Show the transcript of my lecture '마케팅 원론 강의 4주차'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the transcript lines with timestamps and speakers (교수, 학생 1, 학생 2) about the marketing mix (4P).

positive.prompt: What are the action items from my weekly marketing meeting (주간 마케팅 회의)?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the action items recorded in that meeting's AI notes (second blogger campaign, ad video shoot) without inventing owners or deadlines that are not in the notes.

negative.description: Unrelated coding request should not call the tools
negative.prompt: Write a quicksort function in Python.
Email the summary of my last meeting to my coworker.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list recordings, read AI summaries and transcripts, and search recordings (read-only).

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 녹음에 바로 물어보기
ko-KR.description: 서앤오 녹음기(초소형·USB·볼펜)로 녹음하고 서앤오 녹음기 앱에서 만든 AI 노트를 ChatGPT 에서 바로 찾아보고 물어볼 수 있어요. 녹음 목록, AI 요약·할 일, 화자별 대본, 내용 검색을 지원합니다. 녹음은 서버에 저장하지 않고, 같은 계정으로 로그인된 내 PC 프로그램이나 폰 앱이 켜져 있을 때 기기에서 바로 읽어 답합니다. 읽기 전용이며 녹음을 고치거나 지우지 않습니다.
